fx_toy_sack.notes: a toy drops into Marija's sack with a little puff; anchor bottom-centre on the sack (or on the toy when she grabs it from a distance)

fx_hide_sparkle.notes: tiny "shh" sparkle when a kid ducks into a hiding place; centre on the kid

fx_spotted.notes: "!" pops above a kid's head when the beam finds them; bottom-centre 2px above the head, hold the last frame ~0.5s
